verdict.rationale: LobeChat's privacy page notes chat data is stored locally by default with optional cloud sync, and self-hosting/migration docs imply users control where data lives, but there is no explicit documentation of conversation/account deletion controls, retention windows, or data-export/erasure workflows. missing for 10: explicit delete-conversation/account controls, stated retention periods, GDPR-style export/erasure workflow, independent confirmation of deletion behavior.
